title: Pan-Fried Venezuelan Plantain Cakes
description: A crispy, flavorful side dish that combines the natural sweetness of plantains with the savory taste of Venezuelan patties.
instructions: Peel the plantains and slice them into 1-inch rounds.
In a large bowl, mash the plantain slices using a fork or potato masher.
Add the crumbled patties, flour, salt, and pepper to the bowl and mix until well combined.
Heat the oil in a large non-stick skillet over medium-high heat.
Using a 1/4 cup measuring cup, scoop the plantain mixture into the skillet and flatten slightly.
Cook for 3-4 minutes on each side, until the cakes are golden brown and crispy.
